decisions.reason: The quotation-mark treatment is already fully captured by the candidate's same-message MODIFY, and the source does not change its italic-style requirement.

The double full stop is already represented as same-message execution evidence, while the client's correction does not alter the candidate's editorial goal, sentence-clarity rule, or meaning-preservation rule.
The dedication, Mama's Hot Take quotation marks, and duplicate full stop do not change the requirement concerning unintended newline-marker text in the book title.
The source concerns manuscript text corrections and does not change image distortion, cropping, or pixelation requirements.
None of the reported manuscript text updates changes the cover image, trim size, preferred cover visual, or unresolved cover choice.
The source records manuscript edits rather than changing the requested publishing-process, prerequisite, or copyright guidance.
An updated dedication does not necessarily change the independently requested back matter or author lines, and no new required content is specified.
The source does not alter Chapter 18 subtitle hierarchy or the general chapter-heading punctuation and capitalization rules.
The manuscript text corrections do not affect illustration sources, permissions, suitability review, or suitability criteria.
Removing quotation marks and a duplicate full stop does not resume or change the deferred paragraph-spacing and page-density requirement.
The source does not change chapter illustration coverage, placement, presentation, image references, or selected chapter images.
The manuscript text updates do not affect table-of-contents page numbers or their update timing.
